description: The diagonal neck stretch is a neck exercise that helps increase flexibility and range of motion in the neck muscles. It targets the scalene muscles and other lateral neck musculature, which play a crucial role in neck flexion, rotation, and side bending. Regularly performing diagonal neck stretches can significantly improve flexibility and reduce neck discomfort.
